system.description: The shield bearer has learned the art of using a shield in battle, gaining 2 extra Combat Points per level to distribute among parries made with the shield — points usable only when parrying with it. Characters with Shield Bearer also ignore the usual -15 penalty for actions performed with the shield hand (this exception applies only while the character is using a shield).
system.summary: Teaches the art of the shield: extra Combat Points reserved for parries made with it.
